methods_proposed.description: Simple linear model using all available features
methods_proposed.implementation_code:
def predict_linear_regression(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)

def predict_ridge_regression(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    
    model = Ridge(alpha=1.0)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)

def predict_random_forest(train_df, test_df, target_col, date_col, **params):
    from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor
    from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np
    
    X_train = train_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    y_train = train_df[target_col]
    X_test = test_df.drop(columns=[target_col, date_col])
    
    model = RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, max_depth=5, random_state=42)
    model.fit(X_train, y_train)
    predictions = model.predict(X_test)
    
    return pd.DataFrame({'predicted': predictions}, index=test_df.index)
